description: This file defines the ProjectActivityDao class, which manages database interactions related to project activities within the OrangeHRM time plugin. It includes methods for retrieving, counting, saving, validating, copying, and deleting project activities, as well as handling pagination and complex queries involving project activities.

classes.name: ProjectActivityDao
classes.description: Data Access Object class for managing project activity entities, including querying, counting, creating, updating, enforcing validation, copying, and deleting project activities, with support for pagination and complex filtering.

methods.name: getProjectActivityListByProjectId
methods.description: Retrieves a list of project activities associated with a specified project ID, filtered by search parameters.

methods.name: getProjectActivitiesPaginator
methods.description: Creates a paginator for fetching project activities based on project ID and search criteria, with filtering and sorting applied.

methods.name: getProjectActivityCount
methods.description: Returns the total count of project activities for a given project ID based on search filters.

methods.name: saveProjectActivity
methods.description: Persists a new or updated ProjectActivity entity in the database.

methods.name: getProjectById
methods.description: Fetches a Project entity by its ID.

methods.name: getProjectActivityByProjectIdAndProjectActivityId
methods.description: Retrieves a specific ProjectActivity associated with provided project and activity IDs.

methods.name: getExistingProjectActivityIdsForProject
methods.description: Checks which activity IDs already exist for the specified project, preventing duplicates.

methods.name: hasActivityGotTimesheetItems
methods.description: Determines if a project activity has associated timesheet entries, indicating usage.

methods.name: deleteProjectActivities
methods.description: Deletes (marks as deleted) provided project activities, ensuring they are not linked to timesheet items.

methods.name: isProjectActivityNameTaken
methods.description: Validates whether a project activity name is already in use within a project (used for validation during creation or update).

methods.name: getDuplicatedActivities
methods.description: Finds activities with duplicate names across projects, used for integrity checks or merging.

methods.name: getProjectActivitiesByActivityIds
methods.description: Retrieves project activities based on a list of activity IDs.

methods.name: copyActivities
methods.description: Copies activities from one project to another based on provided activity IDs.

methods.name: getActivitiesCountByProjectActivityIdPairs
methods.description: Counts the number of activities matching specific pairs of activity and project IDs, often for validation.

methods.name: getActivitiesPaginatorByProjectActivityIdPairs
methods.description: Creates a paginator for complex queries based on multiple pairs of activity and project IDs.
